en.seoTitle: What Is llms.txt? A Guide to AI-Readable Websites
en.metaDescription: Learn what llms.txt is, why websites are creating AI-readable Markdown indexes, and how SourceShelf uses llms.txt collections for portable AI knowledge.
en.excerpt: llms.txt is an emerging Markdown convention designed to help AI systems discover important website content. Learn what it does, what it does not do, and how SourceShelf uses it.
en.ctaTitle: Create your private AI knowledge base with SourceShelf
en.ctaDescription: Capture, organize, and package selected knowledge locally, then use the format that fits your AI workflow.
en.heroAlt: A website flows through an llms.txt Markdown guide to an AI assistant, with the message Helping AI understand your website.

benefitCards.title: Cleaner AI context

benefitCards.title: Human-readable documentation

benefitCards.title: Future-ready knowledge sharing
benefitCards.description: A lightweight open convention can provide structured context without tying a website to one AI vendor.
